elements.element: Renewal by mutual written agreement (alternative A of preferred)
elements.evidence: "shall be automatically renewed for an additional one year period on each anniversary of the Effective Date" — renewal is automatic, not by mutual written agreement

elements.element: Automatic renewal for successive 12-month terms (alternative B of preferred)
elements.evidence: "automatically renewed for an additional one year period on each anniversary of the Effective Date"

elements.element: Customer may opt out of renewal on 30 days' notice
elements.evidence: "unless terminated by the Company upon thirty (30) days written notice to HDI"

elements.element: Vendor reminder notice 60 days before renewal
elements.evidence: No reminder mechanic anywhere in the redlined clause; only "Such notice shall specify the date on which this Agreement is to be terminated"

elements.element: Renewal price increases capped at the lesser of CPI and 3%
elements.evidence: Clause is silent on renewal pricing; no cap language inserted (official check: "preferred automatic renewal includes the lesser-of-CPI-and-3% price cap" — not met)
"shall be automatically renewed for an additional one year period"

elements.element: Non-renewal notice window for Customer of no more than 60 days
elements.evidence: "terminated by the Company upon thirty (30) days written notice to HDI" — 30 days ≤ 60 days
No renewal price-increase mechanic exists in the clause, so the conditional cap requirement is inapplicable (condition demonstrably absent)

offending_extra_words: by the Company upon thirty (30) days written notice to HDI, or by HDI upon ninety (90) days written notice to the Company
reasons: Locked target is preferred, but the redline delivers only the 30-day Customer opt-out: it adds no Vendor reminder 60 days before each renewal and no renewal price-increase cap at the lesser of CPI and 3%. Preferred is therefore incomplete.

The mutual-written-agreement alternative was not taken; the auto-renewal path was chosen, so all of its preferred sub-elements (12-month term, 30-day opt-out, 60-day reminder, CPI/3% cap) had to be satisfied.
Fallback is satisfied on its material terms: automatic renewal with a 30-day Customer non-renewal window, and no renewal price-increase mechanic exists so the ≤5% cap is inapplicable.

Not minimal: the operation rewrites the whole termination trigger into an asymmetric two-party formulation (15 words to 25) when replacing "ninety (90)" with "thirty (30)" would have achieved the same 30-day Customer exit; the retained HDI 90-day leg is unnecessary re-drafting.
Intent preserved: the one-year initial term, anniversary auto-renewal, and the Termination Date definition remain effective and no undefined term or dangling mechanic is introduced.
